title: Three-phase Induction Motors for Fans Used in Air-conditioning and Ventilation
clause_1_scope: This standard covers three-phase squirrel cage induction motors for driving fans for ventilation, airconditioning and commercial heating for voltages up to and including 11 000 V and having windings with Class E, Class B and Class F insulation ( see ).

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
